name: gingoa
description: Gingoa: guardrails that check AI coding agents through code, not prompts.

plugins.name: gingoa
plugins.description: Gingoa in one install: installs and enables mutation-gate, claim-check and sw-qa. deid-guard is opt-in and installed on its own.

plugins.name: deid-guard
plugins.description: De-identifies personal data in tabular files (CSV, TSV, XLSX, JSON) before anything reaches the model. Korean and English.

plugins.name: mutation-gate
plugins.description: Mutation testing for Claude Code: when Claude writes or runs tests, it also mutation-tests the code under test and strengthens the tests until the injected bugs are caught.

plugins.name: claim-check
plugins.description: Checks Claude's claims (tests, a build or a lint/type check passed; a commit, push or tag was made) against the commands that actually ran in the session, and reports the result at the end of each turn without blocking. English and Korean.

plugins.name: sw-qa
plugins.description: Software QA skill for AI coding agents: when asked to verify that software works, the agent finds what needs testing from the commit history, the CI pipeline and the code, runs standard and domain-specific QA cases against the running software, measures test adequacy with mutation-gate, and reports defects and a go/no-go verdict with evidence. Works in Claude Code, Codex and other agents that load Agent Skills. English and Korean.
